title: Family time at home
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Mondd el, mit látsz a képeken, hasonlítsd össze őket, majd válaszolj a vizsgáztató kérdéseire a saját családodról.

scenes.description: A big family is having Sunday lunch in the garden of a house in a village. Three generations are sitting at a long wooden table: the grandparents, two parents and four children of different ages. The grandmother is bringing a large pot of soup, and a little boy is feeding the dog under the table. Everyone is laughing and the sun is shining.

A father and his teenage daughter are doing housework in a small flat in a big city. The father is ironing shirts in front of the TV, and the girl is vacuuming the living room with headphones on. There is a basket of clean washing on the sofa and a shopping list on the fridge. They both look a little tired, but the girl is singing along to her music.

prompts: Who are the people and what are they doing?
How are the two family situations different?
Which picture is closer to your family's life? Why?
followUpQuestions: Does your family often eat together? When?
Who does most of the housework in your home?
Which household job do you hate the most? Why?
Do you think children should help at home? How much?
What does your family do when relatives visit?

usefulPhrases.en: In the first picture I can see ...
They seem to be enjoying themselves.
While the first family ..., the second ...
usefulPhrases.hu: Míg az első család ..., a második ...

usefulPhrases.en: do the housework / the ironing / the vacuuming
It reminds me of my own family because ...

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: In the first picture a big family is having Sunday lunch in the garden of a village house. Three generations are sitting at a long table, the grandmother is bringing a big pot of soup, and a little boy is feeding the dog under the table. In the second picture a father and his teenage daughter are doing housework in a small city flat. He's ironing shirts, and she's vacuuming with headphones on. The first situation is relaxed and cheerful, while in the second one the people look a bit tired. However, both pictures show families spending time together. The second picture is closer to my family's life, because both of my parents work, so we do the housework together at the weekend.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Do you think children should help at home? How much?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Yes, definitely. I think teenagers should do a few jobs every day, for example the washing-up or taking out the rubbish. That way the parents don't have to do everything.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó megmondja, kik vannak a képeken és mit csinálnak, összeveti a két családi helyzetet (különbség és hasonlóság), indoklással a saját családjához kapcsolja a témát, és a rákérdezésre is véleményt mond.
Szókincs: a család és a házimunka szavai pontosak (three generations, doing housework, ironing, vacuuming, taking out the rubbish).
Nyelvhelyesség: a képleírás folyamatos jelen időben, a családi szokás jelen egyszerű időben áll, a tanácsot a „should” fejezi ki, az ellentétet a „while” és a „However”.
Érdemes megtanulni: „Three generations are sitting at a long table”, „The second picture is closer to my family's life, because …”, „Yes, definitely.”, „That way …”.
